8306.title: Claude per-model usage normalization drops fallback windows
8306.rootCauseOneLine: The Claude usage normalizer ignores model_scoped and emits model windows only from limits, silently losing them when limits has no usable weekly model rows.
8306.proposedFix: Validate model_scoped at the usage boundary and reuse the existing scoped-window normalizer as a fallback when canonical limits yield no model windows.
8306.caveats: Repeated synthetic boundary regression, not a live authenticated CLI throttling capture. Six unrelated provider package failures also reproduce on unchanged main; all 12 relevant usage tests, typecheck, lint, and the repository build pass.
